summary: Taylor's documented position on Palestinian issues is a February 2024 letter calling on the United States to end financial contributions to UNRWA, the UN agency for Palestinian refugees. That action places Taylor on the side of withdrawing aid to Palestinian refugees rather than sustaining it, a stance that runs against Palestinian interests and reflects an Israel-centric policy orientation rather than any commitment to Palestinian justice.
